name: io.github.appsoftwareltd/etherpk
title: EtherPK
description: Read, search and edit an EtherPK knowledge graph of Markdown notes, synced or in a folder.

packageArguments.name: --graph
packageArguments.description: The id or name of a synced graph. Sign in first with the login command.

packageArguments.name: --sync-server
packageArguments.description: The Sync Server that holds the graph, when more than one is signed in.

packageArguments.name: --folder
packageArguments.description: The path of a graph folder, in place of --graph. Needs no sign-in.
